articles.Title: OnMobile Global Q2FY27 Results: Net loss widens to ₹105 crore, revenue dips
articles.Description: Consolidated net loss widened to ₹105.35 crore in Q2FY27 vs profit of ₹59.45 crore in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations declined 0.8% YoY to ₹1,271.02 crore. Finance costs surged to ₹40.89 crore from ₹17.45 crore YoY due to new debenture issuances. Non-current borrowings rose to ₹633.57 crore as company refinanced short-term debt. Cash and cash equivalents increased to ₹1,133.43 crore despite operating cash outflows.
